rule.statement: A court can exercise its inherent powers to restore the status quo ante and prevent abuse of its process, even if the precise situation has not been expressly provided for by statute.
rule.supporting_quote: A court should not permit a litigant to suffer by reason of its own mistake and, as a general rule, should correct such obvious errors by itself.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code
